hercogamous.definition:
a. Not capable of self-fertilization; -- said of
   hermaphrodite flowers in which some structural obstacle forbids
   autogamy.

hercogamy.translation: 雌雄蕊隔离, 自花 受粉阻碍

herculaneum.translation: n. 赫库兰尼姆（因维苏威火山大喷发而埋没的古城）

hercule.translation: n. 赫居里士（希腊神话中大力神）

herculean.definition:
s. displaying superhuman strength or power
s. extremely difficult; requiring the strength of a Hercules

hercules.definition:
n. (classical mythology) a hero noted for his strength; performed 12 immense labors to gain immortality
n. a large constellation in the northern hemisphere between Lyra and Corona Borealis
hercules.translation: n. 赫拉克勒斯(希腊神话中大力士), 大力士, 武仙座

hercules powder process.translation: [化] 赫尔克里士火药公司法(液态烃催化裂化法)

hercules'-club.translation: n. 【植物】；美国南部刺椒 (Zanthoxylum Clava-Herculis)

hercules'-clubs.translation: n. 【植物】；美国南部刺椒 (Zanthoxylum Clava-Herculis)

hercynian.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to an extensive forest in Germany, of
   which there are still portions in Swabia and the Hartz mountains.

hercynine.translation:
[化] 组氨酸三甲基内盐
[医] 组氨酸甜菜硷

hercynite.translation: 铁尖晶石; 铁铝尖晶石
